data.title: Peaceful CoParenting Messenger
data.description:
Co-parenting is a journey that can include bumps in the road, unexpected hurdles and emotional times. Peaceful CoParenting Messenger grows with you on this journey by giving you the tools you need to gain peace with every step.
 
It’s FREE to sign up and FREE to use however you will need a subscription to implement communication boundary features. We offer free use so that co-parents who are reluctant to use the app can still message freely without having to pay. Those co-parents who are more motivated to use the features to restrict messaging can upgrade to have full access. Please read below on how this works.
 
Check out these FREE features:
 
• Safe and Secure: All your data is kept safe in the cloud and available only to you

• Tamper-proof and unalterable documentation of communication to use in legal situations.
 
• Ability to attach documents and photos to share info with your co-parent

• Enjoy knowing the date and time messages are sent and seen 

• Weekly tips that promote healthy communication
 
• Keep the peace using the "bad words" filter
 
• Choose pre-written messages that help co-parents keep the peace
 
• Flag “important” or “offensive” messages
 
• Get resources about healthy communication: books, articles, and co-parenting classes available to you!
 
These “create the peace” features are available with SUBSCRIPTION:
 
• Limit the length of text messages so they're concise and to the point (150 character limit)
 
• Set the number of messages you'd like to receive each day

• Determine the time of day you want to receive messages

• Utilize the ‘Kindness Filter’ to change unproductive, nasty messages into kind, productive co-parenting messages that focus on the children

• Export the entire message communication, or just those within a specific time frame to share with others or print for court-admissible use
 
• Canned messages can force parents to use pre-written messages to cut out the nastiness but keep communication open about the important stuff - your children!
 
• Establish a waiting period if you’d like cooling-off time between messages to promote thoughtful messages and diffuse a heated exchange

• Allow attachments or block attachments
 
Here’s what one user said about Peaceful CoParent:
“On a personal note, this app is EXACTLY what I’ve needed for the last 5 years. Most coparenting apps are focused on finances or scheduling. You all hit the nail on the head with the most IMPORTANT collaboration - respecting boundaries and preventing one another from overstepping them. You saved my sanity, my children’s sanity and all of my friends and family who have stood by powerless and unable to help me. I’m telling everyone I know with a toxic ex about this app! Thanks!”
 
Sometimes it's hard to know how to respond to messages from your co-parent. That's why we give users Resources and Tips right inside the app every day that teach co-parents about healthy communication. Whether issues include child custody, navigating separation and divorce, parenting plans, or litigation and court appearances, Peaceful CoParenting Messenger can help.
 
Bill Eddy, pioneer of the High Conflict Personality Theory, attorney, licensed clinical social worker, speaker, trainer and expert in conflict resolution, contributes to the tips and information we bring to you inside Peaceful CoParent to help you create harmony with your co-parent.  Straight from the High Conflict Institute, we’ve got your back on specific strategies that can help you and your co-parent communicate in a healthier way!
 
We want to hear from you about how to make our app better. Suggest pre-written messages that you think should be added. Give us feedback on how we can improve. We give you our word to take your feedback to heart and make changes for the best product possible. Email support@peacefulparentapp.com.
 
Learn more and join the co-parenting conversation on Facebook @peacefulparentapp.com
